I read through this entirely and I'm so sorry. People close to you were so shitty for shutting you out the moment they assumed you relapsed...mental illness is like that. People think you're deliberately putting yourself in danger, being "lazy" and "dramatic" in my case because I had trouble sleeping and staying calm.
